tooltip.essentialcraft5.accumulator_modu.en: Damage swallowed by a target's hurt cooldown is stored and added to your next hit that lands
tooltip.essentialcraft5.accumulator_modu.zh: 打进对方受击无敌、被整下吞掉的伤害记账，下一下打实时一起结算

tooltip.essentialcraft5.shred_module.en: Every hit you land adds a level of Armor Shred to the target
tooltip.essentialcraft5.shred_module.zh: 打实的每一下给目标叠一层破甲

tooltip.essentialcraft5.phase_anchor_mod.en: Hostile mobs around you, and players you recently traded blows with, cannot teleport away
tooltip.essentialcraft5.phase_anchor_mod.zh: 周围的敌对生物、最近和你互相交过手的玩家都瞬移不走
